high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作针对长程智能体强化学习中轨迹重复、奖励信号难以支持策略优化的问题，把技能从部署时依赖的能力单元改为训练期的自适应支架；支架会随策略变强而删减，因此既能帮助弱策略探索困难任务，又不把显式提示带入部署。论文报告在两个智能体环境上相对强基线最高提升百分之十八点六，并在七个搜索增强问答基准上以少百分之三十二点一的提示词令牌保持竞争力。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

长程智能体的弱策略会重复失败，导致回报轨迹缺乏足够信息来推动策略学习。

02
方法

方法把最新策略的轨迹组整理为证据卡片，并依据任务评估动态调整后续轨迹所使用的上下文。

03
差异

它以策略状态为中心，将技能作为训练期支架而非需要持续保留或内化的固定技能。

04
证据

在阿尔夫世界和网络商店上最高超过强基线百分之十八点六，并在七个搜索增强问答基准上少用百分之三十二点一的提示词令牌而保持竞争力。

摘要

在长程大型语言模型智能体强化学习中，较弱的策略容易重复相似失败，产生缺乏信息的轨迹，从而限制有效的策略优化。帕茨将技能重新定义为随策略变化的训练支架：它把最新策略产生的轨迹组转换为证据卡片，根据任务评估调整后续轨迹的上下文，并用环境奖励和标准的可验证奖励强化学习优化策略；部署时丢弃该支架。在阿尔夫世界和网络商店上，帕茨相对强基线最高提升百分之十八点六；在七个搜索增强问答基准上，它以少百分之三十二点一的提示词令牌保持竞争力。

Gong Gao, Weidong Zhao, Xianhui Liu, Ning Jia
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作把行为先验从固定的离线示范转移到在线回放缓冲区，并用价值引导生成高价值动作，可能同时缓解示范多样性不足、探索低效和在线训练不稳定的问题；对需要高样本效率的机器人与工业控制强化学习尤其有参考价值。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有行为先验强化学习依赖固定的离线示范，容易受到数据多样性不足和轨迹质量不佳的限制。

02
方法

方法使用价值引导的条件变分自编码器从在线回放缓冲区生成策略先验，并结合专家策略引导与策略梯度校正更新策略。

03
差异

它不依赖预先收集的专家轨迹，而是从在线经验中生成高价值动作来指导策略学习。

04
证据

在健身房、物理仿真和动力学控制机器人及工业控制基准上，作者报告了更高的样本效率和更稳定的收敛。

摘要

行为先验强化学习通过利用离线示范中的策略先验提高在线强化学习的样本效率，但静态数据集通常存在数据多样性低和轨迹质量不佳的问题，从而限制策略先验的利用并导致探索低效、训练不稳定。本文提出专家行为先验算法：使用价值引导的条件变分自编码器直接从在线回放缓冲区生成专家策略先验，再通过专家策略引导机制从生成支持集中选择专家动作，并加入策略梯度校正模块协调价值引导与专家监督。机器人控制和工业控制基准上的实验表明，该方法取得了更高的样本效率和更稳定的收敛，并显著优于现有在线强化学习算法。

为什么值得看 这项工作把多模态情绪理解从固定提示转向由强化学习驱动的动态智能体选择与专门化，并用渐进式组相对策略优化把稀疏奖励转成更细粒度的词元学习信号；对关注视频情绪推理、智能体路由和强化学习后训练的研究者尤其值得阅读。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

基于多模态大语言模型的情绪识别通常依赖固定提示，难以处理情绪来源的动态性和复杂性。

02
方法

方法先用合成答案条件链式思维数据与路由数据冷启动，再通过智能体选择和专门化组成的两步流程进行强化学习。

03
差异

渐进式组相对策略优化结合组相对优势与受点互信息启发的渐进式词元调制，以细化稀疏奖励的信用分配。

04
证据

情绪识别基准上的大量实验显示其情绪推理能力更强且优化稳定性更好。

摘要

多模态大语言模型已显著提升多模态情绪识别能力，使复杂情绪理解能够结合视频理解和自然语言描述。现有方法通常使用固定提示，忽略多模态输入中情绪来源的动态性与复杂性；为此，本文提出基于强化学习的动态智能体专门化方法，通过冷启动训练合成的答案条件链式思维数据和智能体路由数据，再以包含智能体选择与专门化的两步流程进行强化学习训练，并设计渐进式组相对策略优化，将稀疏奖励转化为细粒度学习信号，以缓解组相对策略优化中粗粒度的统一信用分配问题。多项情绪识别基准实验显示，该方法具有更强的情绪推理能力和更稳定的优化表现。

Compact Latent Coordination for Autonomous Vehicles at Unsignalized Intersections

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Gil Lifshits, Igal Bilik, Gilad Katz
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 该工作针对无信号交叉口多车强化学习中的组合动作空间、特权信息依赖和固定智能体设计，引入由中心主智能体生成连续协调嵌入、再由分散执行智能体结合局部观测控制车辆的分层机制；在七十二种交叉口配置上实现无碰撞通行，并声称三车训练后零样本扩展到五车时成功率达百分之九十四，适合关注多智能体协同与规模泛化的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

该方法处理无信号交叉口中多车辆协调的组合动作空间、特权信息依赖和固定智能体设计问题。

02
方法

中心主智能体生成表示全局策略的连续原型计划，分散工作智能体将其与局部观测结合完成车辆控制。

03
差异

该设计把战略协调与战术执行解耦，并允许中心规划模块和分散控制模块独立优化。

04
证据

在七十二种高速公路环境交叉口配置上实现无碰撞通行并降低平均行驶时间，三车训练到五车零样本部署的成功率为百分之九十四。

摘要

无信号交叉口中的自动驾驶车辆协调仍是多智能体强化学习面临的关键问题，因为现有系统通常难以处理组合动作空间、依赖特权信息或采用僵化的智能体设计。本文提出主智能体原型计划系统：中心主智能体生成编码全局协调策略的紧凑连续嵌入，即原型计划；分散工作智能体将其与局部观测结合，执行面向具体车辆的控制，从而将战略意图与战术执行分离，并支持两个模块独立优化。作为协调机制的概念验证，系统在高速公路环境中的七十二种交叉口配置上进行测试，实现无碰撞通行并显著降低平均行驶时间，优于基线方法；此外，三车训练的系统在五车场景零样本部署时达到百分之九十四的成功率，显示基于原型计划的分层学习具有多车辆协调和泛化潜力。

Multi-turn RL with Structural and Performance Aware Rewards for CUDA Kernel Generation

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Quazi Ishtiaque Mahmud, Nesreen K. Ahmed, Ali Jannesari
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作把可验证执行结果与代码结构信号同时用于强化学习，使内核生成模型不只追求正确和实测加速，还显式学习内存合并、占用率、算术强度和同步模式等并行化因素。对于研究代码生成后训练和程序优化的读者，它提供了一个多轮反馈方案；论文报告在两类转换任务上最高取得五倍和三点三二倍加速提升，以及百分之十七和百分之七的正确率提升。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有可验证奖励强化学习主要根据正确性和速度评价生成的库达内核，难以直接约束影响性能的程序结构。

02
方法

框架先用对比学习训练离线成对排序模块，再以执行奖励和结构感知奖励进行在线强化学习，并通过执行反馈迭代改写候选程序。

03
差异

奖励同时覆盖正确性、运行性能以及内存合并、占用率、算术强度和同步模式等结构属性，而不是只使用结果信号。

04
证据

在甲语言到库达和火炬程序到库达基准上，论文报告相较指定强基线最高分别有五倍和三点三二倍加速提升，正确率分别提升百分之十七和百分之七。

摘要

针对现有可验证奖励强化学习主要依赖正确性和速度、忽略优化程序关键结构属性的问题，本文提出了库达性能框架，将可验证执行奖励与由内存合并、占用率、算术强度和同步模式等并行化特征得到的结构奖励结合起来。该框架先通过离线对比排序区分优劣程序候选，再在线联合优化正确性、性能和结构效率，并利用执行反馈进行迭代改写；作者还构建了包含二点九千个从甲语言到库达程序、以及一千个从火炬程序到库达程序的数据集，实验显示其相较强基线在加速比和正确率上均有提升。

OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 推理与规划主题tool use / agent workflow
Xiao Yu, Baolin Peng, Ruize Xu, Hao Zou, Qianhui Wu, Hao Cheng et al.
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作解决了智能体强化学习中的关键工程缺口：把多轮推理、工具调用、外部系统访问和有状态并行执行的真实推理 harness 接入标准强化学习栈。它让研究者能直接在部署环境中训练和分析智能体；实验显示，基于数百到数千任务训练的工具型与图形界面智能体在多数基准上超过同规模开放基线，部分图形界面结果可匹敌或超过数倍大的模型，但错误恢复仍是明显短板。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 5）
方法解读
01
问题

标准监督微调和强化学习栈无法原生表达有状态、多进程的 harness 推理流程。

02
方法

轻量代理转发 harness 的模型调用并记录训练数据，容器编排器为每次 rollout 启动独立远程容器，再接入标准强化学习代码库。

03
差异

训练与推理解耦，使同一套训练流程能够直接运行在不同真实 harness 和部署环境中，而非把 harness 简化成单一模型调用。

04
证据

工具型智能体在爪形智能体评测上达到百分之三十一点七的三次全通过率和百分之五十五点九的三次成功率，图形界面智能体在操作系统世界验证集上达到百分之三十七点七，并在多数基准上超过同规模开放基线。

摘要

现代智能体依赖复杂的推理 harness 来完成多轮推理、工具使用和外部系统访问，但这些 harness 难以通过开放基础设施进行端到端训练。本文介绍开放源代码框架开放锻造强化学习：它用轻量代理记录 harness 的模型调用并接入标准强化学习代码库，再用容器编排器为每次 rollout 运行独立的远程容器，从而支持在多种环境中训练 harness 型智能体；在工具型、图形界面浏览器和计算机操作智能体上，框架取得了具有竞争力的基准结果，并发现强化学习能提升自我验证、工具覆盖和多步计划完成能力，但错误恢复仍较弱。

为什么值得看 这篇工作把智能体记忆从单纯的存储与检索问题提升为贯穿输入、作用域、预测、压缩和整合的生命周期管理问题，直接对应生产智能体的上下文膨胀、跨会话漏召回和成本增长。对构建多租户智能体平台的研究者而言，其核心价值是提供一套可拆分的工程接口，并把上下文质量、延迟和令牌效率纳入同一设计目标。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

文章针对对话历史、工具定义和工具输出持续堆积导致的上下文漏召回与令牌成本上升。

02
方法

方法将管理流程拆为架构设计、信息摄取、作用域管理、需求预测以及压缩与整合五个基本环节。

03
差异

它不把记忆局限为存储和检索，而是覆盖按数据类型选存储、保留来源、遗忘、当前相关性判断和组织层级管理。

04
证据

参考实现马克西姆姆·赛纳普在长程记忆评测上报告百分之九十二、在洛科莫评测上报告百分之九十三点二，并讨论延迟、令牌效率和上下文退化。

摘要

生产级人工智能智能体的失败，往往不是推理能力不足，而是无法管理推理上下文中的对话历史、超长提示、大型工具定义和不断膨胀的工具输出。文章将上下文管理定义为一个生命周期，提出架构设计、摄取、作用域管理、需求预测以及压缩与整合五个基本环节，并声称朴素累积会使令牌成本随对话长度呈二次增长，而经过验证的压缩可以在保持信息保真度的同时实现线性成本；其参考实现马克西姆姆·赛纳普在所述配置下于长程记忆评测和洛科莫评测中分别达到百分之九十二和百分之九十三点二。

为什么值得看 该框架把智能体记忆生命周期、评测协议和符号、神经、多模态记忆表示拆开，使研究者能够替换单个组件并隔离记忆设计变量；它对需要比较不同记忆架构或复现实验的智能体研究尤其有用。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有记忆系统难以在不同部署环境间交换组件，也难以独立改变评测协议和记忆类型。

02
方法

框架使用声明式数据契约规范记忆生命周期，并以共享计算接口协调符号、神经和多模态记忆。

03
差异

它将记忆组件、部署环境、基准数据集和执行协议解耦，而不是把它们绑定在单一实现中。

04
证据

Why it matters PATS targets a concrete failure mode in long-horizon agent RL: weak policies repeat low-information rollouts that provide little signal for optimization. Method brief
01
Problem

02
Method

Abstract

In long-horizon LLM agent reinforcement learning, weak policies often repeat similar failures, producing uninformative rollout trajectories and limiting effective policy optimization. Existing skill-centric methods improve exploration by optimizing, filtering, or internalizing reusable skills. However, they remain centered on the skills themselves rather than being designed as adaptive training-time support for the evolving policy. To address this, we propose a policy-centric training paradigm that reframes skills as a dynamic training scaffold. Our framework, Pats, converts rollout groups from the latest policy into evidence cards and uses task-specific evaluation to adjust the context used in subsequent rollouts. Concrete guidance helps weak policies to complete challenging tasks. As policy improves, redundant context is revised or removed to reduce reliance on explicit guidance while preserving useful rollout variation. The policy is optimized with environmental rewards using standard RLVR, and the training scaffold is discarded at deployment. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Pats improves over strong baselines by up to 18.6%. Across seven search-augmented QA benchmarks, it remains competitive while using 32.1% fewer prompt tokens than the baseline.

Abstract

Behavior prior reinforcement learning (BPRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm to improve sample efficiency in online reinforcement learning (RL) by leveraging policy priors derived from offline demonstrations. However, most existing BPRL methods rely on static offline datasets, which often suffer from low data diversity and suboptimal trajectory quality. This reliance restricts the effectiveness of policy priors, hindering both policy exploitation and stability during online training. Consequently, agents are prone to inefficient exploration and unstable learning dynamics. To address these limitations, we deviate from existing offline pre-training methods and propose an Expert Behavior Prior (EBP) algorithm. Specifically, we introduce a Q-guided conditional variational autoencoder (Q-CVAE) that learns to generate expert policy priors directly from the online replay buffer. This enables the generation of high-value actions for guiding policy updates without relying on pre-collected expert trajectories. To further enhance policy exploitation, we propose an expert policy guidance (EPG) mechanism that selects expert actions from a generative support set, and we integrate a policy gradient correction (PGC) module to harmonize Q-guidance with expert supervision, promoting stable and consistent policy improvement. Extensive experiments conducted on robotic control (Gym, PyBullet) and industrial control (DMControl) benchmarks demonstrate that EBP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art online RL algorithms, achieving higher sample efficiency and more stable convergence.

Electroencephalography (EEG) models used for epilepsy are often limited to specific datasets and tasks. This limited approach can make it challenging to apply these models across different datasets or in various situations. However, recent studies in foundation models and self-supervised learning suggest that an adaptable EEG backbone could support a range of EEG related tasks. In this study, we have developed a multimodal EEG foundation model that combines a raw signal encoder based on the Mamba architecture, a Vision Transformer (ViT)-style encoder for time-frequency data, and a lightweight encoder for text, all within a shared embedding space. The pretraining process relies on several innovative techniques, such as masked modeling, cross-view contrastive alignment, and temporal consistency losses. These methods are designed to create rich, seizure-relevant representations without requiring labeled data. To assess the efficacy and generalization of our pretrained model, we fine-tuned it on the canonical CHB-MIT seizure detection benchmark and additional seizure detection datasets, and conducted extensive experiments comparing different model variants. On the standard CHB-MIT split, our best single model achieved an AUROC of 0.874, and an ensemble variant reached 0.878 AUROC, representing state-of-the-art performance on this benchmark. In addition to standard train-test splits, we evaluated performance under a leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) protocol, which is rarely reported in prior EEG seizure modeling work and highlights the difficulty of patient-independent seizure detection, with a mean LOSO balanced accuracy of 0.558 across 19 subjects. Across datasets and evaluation settings, our multimodal foundation model enabled robust seizure detection and straightforward adaptation to new seizure detection scenarios, while also supporting interpretable seizure localization.

Problem

Problem

STORM: RDMA-based Monte Carlo Transport Scheme for Distributed-Memory Particle Simulations

Maor Mizrachi, Barak Raveh, Elad Steinberg
low · 2026-07-22

Why it matters This is not an AI training or serving paper, but its passive receivers, lock-free ring buffers, and one-sided remote-memory transport offer a transferable way to reduce progress overhead when distributed workloads have many communication partners; the paper does not validate the design on AI workloads.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Monte Carlo transport on unstructured meshes exchanges particles among many ranks, while two-sided MPI adds receive-posting and completion-polling overhead that grows with scale.

02
Method

STORM gives each rank pair a single-producer, single-consumer ring buffer and uses one-sided RDMA writes to move particles, with a two-sided MPI backend as a portable fallback.

03
Difference

Receivers remain passive instead of posting receives and polling progress, while the communication layer stays independent of the physics model and mesh representation.

04
Evidence

The RDMA backend reports over 97% weak-scaling and over 88% strong-scaling efficiency through 13,440 cores; the Hohlraum benchmark reports a 1.41x speedup and a 6.1x reduction in MPI progress overhead.

Abstract

Monte Carlo particle transport enables high-fidelity astrophysical radiation and neutrino simulations - from core-collapse supernovae and neutron-star mergers to accretion flows - by handling multidimensional geometries, frequency dependence, and moving media without angular discretization. However, inter-rank communication limits scalability on unstructured meshes: standard two-sided MPI requires receivers to post receives and poll completions, creating per-iteration progress overhead that grows with the number of communication partners. Such problems have not demonstrated high scaling efficiency at $O(10^4)$ cores. We present STORM (Scalable Transport via One-sided Remote Memory), an open-source library for Monte Carlo transport on general meshes, physics, and boundary conditions. STORM provides a lock-free, mesh-independent communication layer that replaces MPI's matched-send/receive semantics with Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) - one-sided operations that write directly into a remote rank's memory without involving its CPU. Each rank pair shares a single-producer, single-consumer ring buffer; RDMA writes transfer particles while receivers remain passive. A two-sided MPI backend provides a portable fallback. In an adversarial uniform-emission benchmark, the RDMA backend sustains $>97\%$ weak-scaling and $>88\%$ strong-scaling efficiency up to 13,440~cores (112~cores per network adapter), with $1.14$-$1.27\times$ speedups over the two-sided alternative. In a Hohlraum IMC benchmark at 4480 ranks, it is $1.41\times$ faster because MPI progress overhead is reduced by $6.1\times$. By decoupling communication from physics models and mesh representations, STORM removes a barrier to scaling Monte Carlo transport in astrophysical multiphysics codes, enabling coupled radiation-hydrodynamics with energy- and angle-resolved photon or neutrino transport on dynamically evolving meshes at scale.

Abstract

Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) global routing is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem requiring signal net assignment across capacity-constrained 3D grids while minimizing congestion, wirelength, and via transitions. Because traditional heuristics rely on static penalty schedules that fail on complex congestion topologies, we present AlphaRoute: a multi-objective adaptive search framework reformulating rip-up and reroute (R&R) into a dynamic optimization system. We introduce SHAP-based overflow decomposition to isolate per-net congestion, driving targeted subgraph extraction via 3D Dijkstra maze routing and an adaptive PathFinder policy. Crucially, AlphaRoute employs Large Language Models (LLMs) as semantic policy optimizers. Bounded by a deterministic knowledge graph, the LLMs interpret congestion metrics to dynamically adjust penalty parameters. On the constrained ARIANE design, we achieve an overflow of 146,109 (a 29.8x reduction in overflow over the state of the art), yielding a penalized score of S_orig = 0.0538 versus the State-of-the-art (SOTA) 1.780. These results demonstrate that superior algorithmic search geometry can overcome the latency of interpreted Python implementations.

Abstract

We introduce the Directional Kernel Mean Difference (DKMD), a signed statistic for univariate distribution comparison that preserves the direction of distributional shifts. Unlike the squared Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), which discards directional information by squaring the RKHS distance, DKMD integrates the difference of kernel mean embeddings against a fixed odd weighting function. This construction yields three structural properties: antisymmetry, immunity to symmetric distributional differences, and directional monotonicity under stochastic dominance. We derive a data-driven Riemann estimator that ensures asymptotic consistency with the continuous formulation, strictly preserving the theoretical guarantees of the signed statistic in empirical evaluations. To overcome the quadratic computational cost of kernel methods, we develop an $O(N \log N)$ prefix--suffix scanning algorithm that exploits the total order of the real line while requiring only $O(N)$ memory. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that DKMD correctly isolates directional shifts from symmetric perturbations, remains robust to heavy-tailed outliers that can flip the sign of the mean difference, and scales to millions of samples in seconds.

Abstract

Each planning task from static network planning to dynamic warehouse assortment planning requires analysts to spend weeks building models from scratch, calibrating and persuading executives to act on outputs they cannot verify. Three barriers drive this: bespoke models proliferate because standardization is difficult (operational fragmentation); once unified, the combinatorial scale of millions of SKUs, thousands of nodes, and intricate routing logic exceeds what solvers can handle within a tight window (computational intractability); and a mathematically optimal solution still fails to be implemented if the executives do not trust it (implementation hurdle). The central insight is decoupling: simulation proposes by generating and evaluating the full set of operationally valid candidate paths-absorbing all idiosyncratic business logic, while an integer program disposes by selecting the globally optimal subset. Computationally, matrix-vectorized CPU/GPU accelerated simulation achieves a 10-100 times speedup over serial methods, and a list scheduling algorithm reduces coupled-order processing from hours to minutes. SPORD moves simulation from monitoring to active planning.
